crossRefs.note: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”
The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and…

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: Zarephath
people.line: A Phoenician city where Elijah stayed with a widow

translations.web: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
translations.bsb: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to the widow of Zarephath in Sidon.
translations.kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
translations.asv: and unto none of them was Elijah sent, but only to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
